# ProofHub

> ProofHub is a comprehensive project management and collaboration platform offering task management, Gantt charts, time-tracking, and team coordination tools.

ProofHub provides both product documentation and customer support resources through its help center. The platform includes ProofHub Swift, a dedicated interface for streamlined project management workflows.

## Key Topics

- Project Management
- Task Management
- Gantt Charts
- Time Tracking
- ProofHub Swift
- Team Collaboration
- Documentation
- Getting Started
- Customer Support
- Contact Support

## Product Documentation

- [ProofHub Swift Guide](https://help.proofhub.com/swift): ProofHub Swift guides covering project management, tasks, Gantt charts, and time-tracking.

## Customer Support

- [Contact Support](https://help.proofhub.com/plus/contact): ProofHub contact support page with multiple channels including email and Twitter.
